title: A Samurai in Peacetime Japan
hook: The deadliest warriors traded their swords for ink brushes.

scenes.text: During the long peace of the Edo period, Japan's samurai faced an unexpected crisis: no wars to fight.

scenes.text: Instead of storming castles, samurai were transformed into government bureaucrats and tax auditors.

scenes.text: You still wore two ceremonial swords in your sash by law, but you spent your days filing paperwork.

scenes.text: Your pay was fixed in koku—baskets of rice—which lost value as merchants grew wealthier.
